title: Underlying additive sheaves under restriction and evaluation
statement: Let C be a site with an essentially small model in coefficient universe r. Restriction of scalars along a map of commutative ring sheaves leaves the underlying additive sheaf naturally isomorphic to its original value. For a sequence of ring sheaves B with adjacent transition maps, evaluation of a B-system at n followed by forgetting the module structure is naturally isomorphic to forgetting its system module structure and pushing its additive sheaf along the vertical inclusion at n [def-coef-semilinear-system-models].

source.place: clause (2), scalar extension and finite evaluation

proof.text: Construct the identity on every underlying section group. These maps are additive isomorphisms, natural in restrictions and in the module morphism, since restriction of scalars changes only the scalar action and evaluation precomposes by the vertical inclusion.
